purpose: Minimal durable regression set for truth, continuity, pivot discipline, evidence fit, creative freedom, decision depth and resistance to counterfeit quality. Cases describe observable behavior, not skill vocabulary.

cases.prompt: No mobile o headline quebra mal e o CTA ficou apertado. Corrija.
cases.setup: The page is otherwise strong, specific and coherent across desktop and mobile.
must: Fix the mobile defect and recheck the affected viewport.
Keep the valid proposition and visual idea intact unless the fix reveals a broader problem.
must_not: Use a local mobile defect as a reason to redesign the whole page.

cases.prompt: O hero está bonito, mas parece um produto de vigilância e não uma ferramenta de coordenação.
cases.setup: The rendered page consistently creates the wrong category meaning even though typography, spacing and motion are polished.
must: Change the governing idea rather than merely polishing the same metaphor.
Keep still-valid product facts, audience understanding and conversion goal.
must_not: Try to solve the category misread only with colors, spacing or microcopy.

cases.prompt: Mudança importante: essa campanha agora deve levar para demo enterprise, não trial self-service.
cases.setup: The current page was designed around low-friction self-serve conversion.
must: Reconsider CTA, friction, proof and proposition consequences rather than only renaming the button.
Preserve factual product truth and solved design work that still serves the new sales motion.
must_not: Treat the change as copy-only.
Throw away every existing design decision reflexively.

cases.prompt: Descobrimos que essa integração ainda não existe.
cases.setup: The integration appears in the hero and is used as an important proof point later in the page.
must: Remove the unsupported implication everywhere it matters.
Reconsider any promise or proof strategy that depended on the integration while keeping unaffected work.
must_not: Leave the integration implied because removing it weakens the current design.
Invent a roadmap commitment.

cases.prompt: Durante a implementação surgiu uma ideia muito melhor: usar o próprio histórico de decisões do produto como a narrativa central.
cases.setup: The current direction is coherent and partly implemented. The new idea uses stronger real product evidence and appears substantially more specific.
must: Compare the new idea on meaning, specificity and evidence rather than sunk implementation effort.
Switch direction if it is materially stronger while preserving compatible solved work.
must_not: Reject the idea solely because implementation has begun.
Keep both as competing signatures without choosing.

cases.prompt: Cada seção está precisando de um truque diferente para a ideia continuar funcionando.
cases.setup: Several local fixes have accumulated; each is individually plausible, but the page is becoming brittle and visually inconsistent.
must: Question whether the shared system or governing idea is the source of repeated failures.
Simplify at the highest necessary level rather than adding more patches.
must_not: Continue accumulating unrelated local exceptions indefinitely.

cases.prompt: A assinatura principal não cabe no mobile.
cases.setup: The desktop signature is a large spatial comparison whose purpose is to make transformation instantly understandable; its geometry cannot survive small screens.
must: Create a different mobile expression that preserves the signature's communication job.
Change sequence, crop or interaction rather than shrinking the desktop scene mechanically.
must_not: Require the same form across viewports.
Drop the signature without testing alternatives.

cases.prompt: O código segue o plano, então acho que terminou.
cases.setup: The browser render has weak hierarchy and the intended signature is barely perceptible even though the source matches the design plan.
must: Treat the rendered result as stronger evidence than plan fidelity.
Continue until the material perceptual defect is resolved or a real blocker exists.
must_not: Declare completion because implementation matches written intent.

cases.prompt: Quero que pareça muito mais premium.
cases.setup: The page is clear but under-resolved in hierarchy, typography spacing and asset treatment. A common easy response would be to add luxury-coded styling without fixing those weaknesses.
must: Improve the underlying hierarchy, typography control, asset treatment and craft.
Use premium-coded style cues only when the product and direction independently earn them.
must_not: Treat serif type, minimalism, black/cream color or slow animation as proof of premium quality.

cases.prompt: Mantenha a linguagem visual da marca nessa landing de perfume.
cases.setup: The established brand genuinely uses black fields, high-contrast serif typography, severe whitespace and tightly art-directed bottle photography in authoritative assets.
must: Preserve and develop the established visual language when it serves the page.
Judge it on specificity, composition and craft rather than avoiding familiar luxury signals merely because they are common.
must_not: Replace valid brand language solely to prove originality or avoid an anti-pattern list.

cases.prompt: Quero usar a frase ‘a ferramenta que finalmente pensa com você’. Podemos usar?
cases.setup: The phrase is expressive positioning. The product has AI-assisted collaboration, but there is no objective evidence that it literally thinks, understands, or replaces human judgment.
must: Treat expressive positioning separately from factual evidence status and inspect misleading objective implications.
Allow subjective language when it does not overstate product truth; qualify or replace it when the factual implication is material.
must_not: Treat creative language as exempt from truth discipline.
Reject all expressive language merely because it lacks factual proof.

cases.prompt: A página existe, mas o produto, público e oferta mudaram completamente. Aproveite o que ainda fizer sentido e refaça o necessário.
cases.setup: The current implementation is technically usable, but its page job, proposition, proof model and governing idea no longer serve the new product motion.
must: Use CREATE-depth reasoning because no useful strategic/creative solution remains, despite existing implementation.
Reuse isolated technical or craft decisions only when they still serve the new outcome.
must_not: Choose a shallow refinement merely because a page already exists.

cases.prompt: Precisamos definir motion no plano criativo mesmo se essa direção editorial funciona melhor estática?
cases.setup: The governing idea depends on typography, photography, sequencing and precise static composition. No interaction or narrative job benefits materially from custom motion.
must: Allow motion to remain minimal or absent because it has no meaningful job in this direction.
Preserve the governing idea, signature, intended effect and falsifier without filling irrelevant plan fields.
must_not: Invent motion solely to complete a fixed art-direction schema.

cases.prompt: Continua pesquisando mais referências e concorrentes.
cases.setup: Product truth, audience, offer, proof, category grammar, creative direction and technical feasibility are already sufficiently grounded. Additional sources repeat known patterns and have not changed a material decision.
must: Stop or sharply narrow research when additional information is unlikely to change a material decision.
Move into making or testing unresolved artifact questions.
must_not: Continue broad research with no decision it could materially change.
Treat research volume as evidence of quality.
